resourceType.why: what kind of object the row is, for a table that stores more than one kind

schemaVersion.why: the shape a stored row was written against, a property of the canonical schema rather than of each row

ownerAccount.why: the account the row belongs to, the value every isolation policy compares against

organization.why: the organization the row is scoped to, null for a personal row

workspace.why: the workspace the row is filed under, for a tenant that partitions its work

project.why: the project the row is filed under, null when it is loose

createdBy.why: the principal that created the row, which is not always its owner

updatedBy.why: the principal that last wrote the row

createdAt.why: when the row came into existence

updatedAt.why: when the row was last written

deletedAt.why: when the row was soft deleted, null while it is alive

archivedAt.why: when the row was archived, which hides it without deleting it

version.why: the optimistic-concurrency token an If-Match precondition quotes

visibility.why: who may read the row beyond its owner

retentionClass.why: how long the row is kept before a retention sweep removes it

source.why: what produced the row, for a table fed by more than one path

originSurface.why: which product surface produced the row

parent.why: the owning row, for a child object whose ownership is its parent's

operationId.why: the handle a caller quotes to ask about this run and nothing else

startedAt.why: when the work actually began, which is not when the row was created

progress.why: how far along it is, for work a reader waits on

stage.why: which step it is in, in the shared lifecycle vocabulary

cancellation.why: that a stop was asked for, so a worker can honour it and a reader can be told

retry.why: how many times it has been tried, so a replay is bounded

result.why: what it produced, readable after the caller has gone

error.why: why it failed, kept apart from the result

requestId.why: the reference a reader quotes to support

cost.why: what it spent, so a bill can be explained

completedAt.why: when it ended, which is what a duration is measured against

gaps.why: the share row records only when the link dies, never who the link was meant for.
gaps.fix: add visibility alongside the token and have the share route read it, as published_artifacts does.

undeclaredDispositions.why: predates the convention; the implicit no action blocks the parent delete, which is safe but undeclared.

projects.why: a project is edited from more than one device at once

project-instructions.why: the instructions live on the project row and two editors overwrite each other

artifacts.why: an artifact is edited while a run is still writing to it

documents.why: a knowledge file is replaced while another reader is citing it

policies.why: two administrators edit the same tenant policy

settings.why: settings are written from every surface the account signs in to

memory-summary.why: a summary is rewritten by a run while the reader is editing it

shared-resources.why: a published artifact is republished while someone holds the link

schedules.why: a schedule is edited while the dispatcher is reading it

agent-definitions.why: an agent definition is edited while a run is loading it

childDispositionsNotUsed.archive_child: No parent archives its children. Archive is a per-resource flag a surface writes, and nothing reads a parent archive to decide a child is archived too.
childDispositionsNotUsed.ask_user: No deletion offers the owner a choice about the children. Every parent delete either cascades or is blocked, and the confirmation names the consequence rather than asking for a disposition.
childDispositionsNotUsed.preserve_shared_derivative: A published artifact cascades from the conversation it came from, so no derivative outlives its parent once the parent is really gone. Soft delete is what keeps the derivative reachable today.
childDispositionsNotUsed.preserve_external_source: Nothing in the schema owns a row in somebody else external system. A connector holds a grant, and revoking it leaves the external document untouched because no row here points at it.
